name: 07424 · Little Falls, NJ
findings: ZIP 07424 (Little Falls) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07424 (Little Falls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
